title: SkillSinc configuration
description: SkillSinc config.json. Comments and trailing commas are allowed. Reference: https://github.com/mikejhill/skillsinc/blob/main/docs/guides/configuration.md

$schema.description: JSON Schema for editors. SkillSinc keeps ./config.schema.json up to date beside this file.

project.description: Project root, relative to this file, that makes this a project configuration.

sources.description: Libraries of authored customizations, by name.

destinations.description: Harness folders that receive customizations, by name.

routes.description: Which items flow from which sources to which destinations.

source.description: Give exactly one of path, github, or git.

path.description: Library directory; relative paths resolve against this file.

ref.description: Branch, tag, refs/... name, or full commit SHA. Default: the remote's HEAD.

subdirectory.description: Relative path, using /, of the library inside the repository.

refresh.description: Shortest time between remote checks, such as 15m or 1h (1m to 31d). Default: every run.

layout.description: Subdirectory of each kind, and of plugins.

exclude.description: File and directory names never read.

include.description: Selectors of the items this source offers. Default: ["*/*"].

disabled.description: Selectors suppressed across every route from this source.

rename.description: New item names by exact kind/name or plugins/plugin/kind/name selector.

profile.description: Harness profile. Default: the destination name.

path.description: Directory the harness reads. Required for generic.

enabled.description: false skips the destination entirely. Default: true.

include.description: kind/name glob patterns to select. Default: ["*/*"].

exclude.description: kind/name glob patterns to drop after include.

allow_lossy.description: Accept conversions that drop fields or change activation. Default: false.
